sentences.english: Please feed the dog.
sentences.chinese: 请喂一下狗。

sentences.english: Can you feed the cat while I'm on vacation?
sentences.chinese: 我去度假的时候你能帮我喂猫吗？
sentences.scene: 请邻居或朋友帮忙照看宠物

sentences.english: My little sister loves to feed the ducks at the pond, but we always make sure to give them proper food like peas instead of bread.
sentences.chinese: 我妹妹喜欢在池塘边喂鸭子，但我们总会确保给它们合适的食物比如豌豆，而不是面包。
sentences.scene: 教导孩子正确喂食小动物

sentences.english: Please pass the salt.
sentences.chinese: 请把盐递一下。

sentences.english: Could you pass me the remote control? It's on the table.
sentences.chinese: 你能把遥控器递给我吗？在桌子上。
sentences.scene: 看电视时请家人递遥控器

sentences.english: During dinner, my dad always asks me to pass the salad bowl, and without fail, I almost drop it every single time.
sentences.chinese: 吃晚饭时我爸总让我递沙拉碗，而我每次都差一点把它弄掉。
sentences.scene: 家庭聚餐时的搞笑小插曲

sentences.english: Pick a number between one and ten.
sentences.chinese: 从一到十之间选个数字。

sentences.english: We went to the farm to pick strawberries.
sentences.chinese: 我们去农场摘了草莓。

sentences.english: Every fall, we drive up to the mountains to pick apples and then spend the weekend baking pies.
sentences.chinese: 每年秋天我们都会开车去山上摘苹果，然后整个周末都在烤苹果派。
sentences.scene: 秋日家庭摘苹果的传统

sentences.english: I drink milk every morning.
sentences.chinese: 我每天早上喝牛奶。

sentences.english: Don't forget to buy a carton of milk on your way home.
sentences.chinese: 回家路上别忘了买一盒牛奶。

sentences.english: When I stayed on my uncle's farm, I learned how to milk a cow, and it was harder than it looks.
sentences.chinese: 我在叔叔的农场住的时候学会了挤牛奶，那比看起来难多了。

sentences.english: Be careful with that knife.
sentences.chinese: 小心那把刀。
sentences.scene: 看到孩子拿刀时的提醒

sentences.english: I need a sharp knife to cut the steak.
sentences.chinese: 我需要一把快刀来切牛排。
sentences.scene: 吃牛排时抱怨刀不够锋利

sentences.english: While camping, we realized we forgot a knife, so we had to cut vegetables with a plastic one from the picnic set.
sentences.chinese: 露营时我们发现忘了带刀，只好用野餐套装里的塑料刀切蔬菜。
sentences.scene: 露营忘带重要工具的窘迫

sentences.english: Use a fork for your salad.
sentences.chinese: 用叉子吃沙拉。
sentences.scene: 餐桌上指导孩子用餐具

sentences.english: I dropped my fork on the floor, so I asked the waiter for a new one.
sentences.chinese: 我把叉子掉地上了，于是向服务员要了把新的。

sentences.english: At the fancy restaurant, I accidentally used the wrong fork for the appetizer and felt really embarrassed.
sentences.chinese: 在那家高级餐厅，我前菜不小心用错了叉子，觉得好尴尬。
sentences.scene: 正式场合用错餐具的窘态

sentences.english: Can you use chopsticks?
sentences.chinese: 你会用筷子吗？

sentences.english: I'm learning to eat with chopsticks, but I'm still pretty slow.
sentences.chinese: 我正在学用筷子吃饭，但速度还很慢。

sentences.english: For Chinese New Year, my friend taught me how to pick up a single grain of rice with chopsticks, but I never mastered it.
sentences.chinese: 过春节时朋友教我如何用筷子夹起一粒米，但我始终没学会。

sentences.english: Don't waste water.
sentences.chinese: 别浪费水。
sentences.scene: 孩子开着水龙头玩时被制止

sentences.english: It's a waste to throw away all this leftover food; we can eat it tomorrow.
sentences.chinese: 把这些剩菜扔掉太浪费了，我们明天可以吃。

sentences.english: My mom always tells us not to waste food because she grew up without much and knows how precious it is.
sentences.chinese: 妈妈总叫我们不要浪费粮食，因为她小时候没多少吃的，深知食物的珍贵。

sentences.english: The food smells great.
sentences.chinese: 这食物闻起来好香。

sentences.english: There's a food truck parked outside the office that sells amazing tacos.
sentences.chinese: 办公室外停了一辆快餐车，卖的墨西哥卷饼超好吃。
sentences.scene: 发现办公楼下美食餐车

sentences.english: Street food might look a bit messy, but it's often the most delicious food you can find in a city.
sentences.chinese: 街头小吃也许看着不太讲究，但它往往是一座城市里最美味的东西。
sentences.scene: 表达对街头小吃的热爱

sentences.english: This cake is delicious!
sentences.chinese: 这蛋糕真好吃！

sentences.english: My grandmother makes the most delicious chocolate chip cookies.
sentences.chinese: 我奶奶做的巧克力曲奇好吃极了。

sentences.english: The soup looked a little strange, but after one spoonful, I had to admit it was the most delicious thing I'd ever tasted.
sentences.chinese: 那汤看着有点奇怪，但喝了一勺后我不得不承认这是我这辈子吃过的最美味的东西。
sentences.scene: 外貌不扬但味道惊艳的食物

sentences.english: Please clear the table after dinner.
sentences.chinese: 吃完饭后请把桌子收拾了。

sentences.english: The kids take turns to clear the table and load the dishwasher each night.
sentences.chinese: 孩子们每晚轮流收拾餐桌并把碗放进洗碗机。

sentences.english: After the big party, it took us almost an hour to clear the table and wash all the dishes.
sentences.chinese: 大型派对结束后，我们花了快一小时才把餐桌收拾好并洗完了所有碗碟。

sentences.english: Can you help set the table?
sentences.chinese: 你能帮忙摆一下碗筷吗？

sentences.english: I asked my son to set the table, but he forgot the napkins.
sentences.chinese: 我叫儿子去摆餐桌，但他忘了放餐巾纸。

sentences.english: For Thanksgiving, my mom sets the table with the fancy china and candles, making it look like a magazine cover.
sentences.chinese: 感恩节时妈妈会用精美的瓷器和蜡烛布置餐桌，好看得像杂志封面。

sentences.english: I had a bowl of soup for lunch.
sentences.chinese: 我午饭喝了一碗汤。

sentences.english: Can you put the popcorn in a large bowl?
sentences.chinese: 你能把爆米花倒进一个大碗里吗？

sentences.english: My favorite breakfast is a smoothie bowl topped with fresh fruit and granola.
sentences.chinese: 我最爱的早餐是一碗果昔，上面铺满新鲜水果和麦片。

sentences.english: Stir the coffee with a spoon.
sentences.chinese: 用勺子搅拌咖啡。

sentences.english: I need a bigger spoon to eat my cereal properly.
sentences.chinese: 我吃麦片需要个大点儿的勺子才顺手。
sentences.scene: 吃早餐时发现餐具不合适

sentences.english: When I was a kid, I used to pretend the spoon was an airplane to get my little brother to eat his food.
sentences.chinese: 我小时候为了哄弟弟吃饭，总会把勺子假扮成飞机。
sentences.scene: 用游戏的方式喂小孩吃饭

sentences.english: I'm going to the supermarket.
sentences.chinese: 我要去超市。

sentences.english: We forgot to buy eggs, so I have to run to the supermarket before it closes.
sentences.chinese: 我们忘了买鸡蛋，我得赶在超市关门前跑一趟。
sentences.scene: 临时发现缺食材赶紧补买

sentences.english: My favorite part of the supermarket is the bakery section because it always smells like fresh bread.
sentences.chinese: 超市里我最喜欢的就是烘焙区，因为那里总飘着新鲜面包的香味。
sentences.scene: 逛超市时被烘焙区吸引

sentences.english: She did it by herself.
sentences.chinese: 她全靠自己完成的。
sentences.scene: 表扬女孩独立完成任务

sentences.english: My little girl dressed herself this morning, and the shirt was inside out.
sentences.chinese: 今天早上我女儿自己穿的衣服，结果把衬衫穿反了。
sentences.scene: 幼儿自己穿衣的可爱成果

sentences.english: Even though she was nervous, she gave the entire presentation by herself and did an amazing job.
sentences.chinese: 尽管很紧张，她还是独自完成了整个演讲，而且表现得非常棒。
sentences.scene: 女孩勇敢地独立完成演讲

sentences.english: I'll see you next week.
sentences.chinese: 下周见。

sentences.english: This week has been so long; I can't wait for the weekend.
sentences.chinese: 这周好漫长，我等不及到周末了。

sentences.english: I've been looking forward to this vacation for weeks, and now that it's finally here, I plan to do absolutely nothing.
sentences.chinese: 我期待这个假期好几周了，现在终于来了，我打算啥也不干。
sentences.scene: 对假期的极度期待与放松计划

sentences.english: I'll have the chicken salad.
sentences.chinese: 我要鸡肉沙拉。

sentences.english: For a quick lunch, I just throw a salad together with whatever veggies I have.
sentences.chinese: 为了快手午餐，我随便把现有蔬菜拌了个沙拉。

sentences.english: I tried to make a healthy salad, but then I added so much cheese and dressing that I'm not sure it counts anymore.
sentences.chinese: 我本想做份健康沙拉，但加了太多奶酪和沙拉酱后，我不确定这还算不算健康了。
sentences.scene: 自制沙拉变高热量食物的趣事
